review_candidates.title: Modern Workplace Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You’ll be in the detail - configuring Intune, managing policies, deploying packages, and maintaining cloud services—but also stepping back to help us continuously improve how our workplace technology operates. You’ll be getting up to a range of tasks and responsibilities, including; Modern Workplace & Cloud Management Deploying, configuring, and optimising Microsoft 365, Intune, Defender, and Azure services Owning device management, including policy configuration and application deployment via I

This is a great role for someone who wants to: Be hands-on with modern workplace and cloud technologies Take ownership of key platforms like Intune and Microsoft 365 Lead and contribute to technical projects and improvements Build expertise across infrastructure, security, AI and automation Work in a collaborative team where your input genuinely matters We’re not trying to overcomplicate things—we’re focused on building an environment that is reliable, secure, and continuously improving , and you’ll play a key part in that.
